svg.title: Bloom filters
svg.desc: Two likes are added to a Bloom filter, each hashed three ways to set three bits. A lookup for post 991 hits a zero bit, so the disk read is skipped. Post 12 finds all three bits set and is found on disk. Post 77 also finds all bits set by other items, reads the disk, and finds nothing: a false positive.
svg.text: Bloom filter for file 4, in memory
Any zero bit means definitely not. All ones only means maybe.
